stage0003_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He's totally weird, that guy!
　Whatever he says makes no sense at all,
　and during breaks he just paces the halls...」

stage0003_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's right!
　Guys who can't sit still like that
　just drive me crazy to watch!」

stage0003_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$恭子$$
「Then just don't look at him.」

stage0003_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not looking, that weirdo!
　And, and get this! Sometimes our eyes meet!
　He's the one looking at me!」

stage0003_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He makes this 'oh, what a coincidence' face
　and looks away, but it's so obvious!
　Ugh, it's creepy...!」

stage0003_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But that's not it!
　Those are a creep's eyes!」

stage0003_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$恭子$$
「You've been bad-mouthing Sagara nonstop, Kana.」

stage0003_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$恭子$$
「Yeah.
　Do you really care about him that much?」

stage0003_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wh... no way! Hah, hahahaha!
　...Uh, whoa...」

stage0003_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$恭子$$
「See, that's what happens when you laugh
　that hard with your head thrown back...」

stage0003_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Everyone, down!
　Hands on your heads!
　Anyone who resists gets shot!」

stage0003_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What do you mean, shoot!?
　Charging in with that toy gun while I'm
　changing, who do you think you are!?」

stage0003_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$宗介$$
「I... I heard you scream, so...」

stage0003_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I just tripped on my own, that's all!
　Besides, what's my scream got to do with you!?」

stage0003_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$宗介$$
「...That I cannot say.
　You are not qualified to know.」

stage0003_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$恭子$$
「Sagara... why did you come here?」

stage0003_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$宗介$$
「...At my previous school, I was also active
　in this same club. I take pride in that.
　I have confidence in my physical stamina.」

stage0003_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$宗介$$
「I do not think hiring me would be a loss.
　What do you say?」

stage0003_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「This is the girls' softball club!!」

stage0003_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$恭子$$
「That got him right in the face...」

stage0003_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$n
「$$宗介$$, so this is where you were.」

stage0003_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$l!
　You'd better keep Sagara in line!!」

stage0003_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Put a rope on his neck and lock him in a shed
　so he can't pull any more weird stunts!」

stage0003_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$n
「I... I'm not sure what happened, but sorry...!
　Let's go, $$宗介$$!」

stage0003_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Honestly!
　What is with that guy!!」

stage0003_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$恭子$$
「But Sagara... he was worried about you, Kana...」

stage0003_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$n
「I am not doing this because I enjoy it.
　Thanks to your antics, I have become
　your full-time watchdog.」

stage0003_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$n
「And after this, I am sure
　Chidori will call and chew me out for it.」

stage0003_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$宗介$$
「You got $$千鳥かなめ$$'s cell number?」

stage0003_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$n
「After a few days together, I've realized...
　you infiltrated this school
　to guard $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

stage0003_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$宗介$$
「No use hiding it now...
　Confirmed.」

stage0003_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$n
「But why exactly are you guarding her?
　Is she worth enough for $$ミスリル$$ to protect?」

stage0003_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$n
「Not going to talk, huh...
　Or is it that you don't know either?」

stage0003_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$n
「Fine, whatever...
　It's not like I'm all that interested anyway.」

stage0003_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$n
「But I have a problem with your methods.
　Don't bring your fighting into this school.」

stage0003_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$n
「The students here aren't like you, a mercenary,
　or me. Don't go wrecking the life they have.」

stage0003_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's nothing urgent, really...
　You two transfer students seem to get along.」

stage0003_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宗介$$
「This is nothing but a nuisance to me.」

stage0003_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh heh... You two seem to click.」

stage0003_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$n
「If there's nothing else, we'll take our leave.」

stage0003_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$オズマ$$
「...Here are the minutes from the meeting
　with Captain Testarossa, plus a classified
　letter of orders addressed to her.」

stage0003_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What's the situation in each region?」

stage0003_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$オズマ$$
「According to $$ミスリル$$'s intel,
　Neo Zeon does appear to be stirring.」

stage0003_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is their leader, $$ハマーン・カーン$$, planning to prop up
　a Zabi heir and break from the Federation?」

stage0003_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Who knows...
　The Zabi name carried weight back in 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》,
　but it holds little sway in this world.」

stage0003_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$オズマ$$
「It lacks the pull to rally $$プラント$$
　or the colony nations of 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》.」

stage0003_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But if they won't challenge us head-on,
　they may resort to guerrilla tactics instead.」

stage0003_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「A real headache for the Federation forces.
　If Neo Zeon rallies the colonies
　and moves against the Federation...」

stage0003_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$オズマ$$
「...the Earth Federation Forces would be
　split clean in two, Earth and space.」

stage0003_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And tightening our watch on space
　breeds tension, and stirs up bad blood.」

stage0003_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「At the same time, we lose our grip
　on those sharpening their fangs behind the peace.」

stage0003_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$オズマ$$
「And that's where the likes of us
　and $$ミスリル$$ come in, is that it?」

stage0003_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Exactly.
　We may need to bolster our forces even more...」

stage0003_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And what did $$ミスリル$$'s intelligence division
　turn up on $F's background?」

stage0003_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$F...
　Born in Japan, but they moved to 《$$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$》
　right after, and lived there until last year.」

stage0003_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Their parents divorced young, and their mother
　raised them, but she died in an accident when
　they were five. Their father and sister took them in.」

stage0003_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$オズマ$$
「But last year, their father and sister also died
　in an accident, and they traced a distant relative
　back to Japan. They now live in Jindai's dorms.」

stage0003_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Sounds like they've been through quite a lot...」

stage0003_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$オズマ$$
「One point worth noting: their father
　once served in the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$'s
　Black Berets...」

stage0003_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$オズマ$$
「After the divorce, he reportedly worked
　as a 《$$ビーストハンター$$》 in Alaska.」

stage0003_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「A $$ビーストハンター$$... Someone who makes a living
　trapping and culling beasts from other dimensions...」

stage0003_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The field skills in Sergeant $$相良宗介$$'s
　report were likely taught by that father.」

stage0003_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Whatever their past may be,
　they're an $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ special operative now.
　I'll make a proper soldier of them.」

stage0003_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's likely what they want themselves.
　Train them hard, don't hold back.」

stage0003_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$オズマ$$
「On a related note,
　I'd like to put the unit through special
　training for future operations...」

stage0003_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$ミスリル$$'s left field deployment to us as well.
　Use your own judgment, Major.」

stage0003_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Understood.
　After my meeting with Sergeant $$マオ$$,
　I'll get right to putting them through it.」

stage0003_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$オズマ$$
「As you're all already aware,
　$$ミスリル$$'s $$ＳＲＴ$$ and $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$
　will be operating together.」

stage0003_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$オズマ$$
「As of today, $$ミスリル$$ has officially joined us
　aboard the Quarter. Let's have everyone
　introduce themselves.」

stage0003_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'll start...
　Major $$オズマ・リー$$, $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$
　I command this unit's front line.」

stage0003_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$マオ$$
「Master Sergeant $$メリッサ・マオ$$, $$ＳＲＴ$$.
　Callsign's $$ウルズ$$ 2.」

stage0003_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Sergeant $$マオ$$ will serve as this unit's
　second-in-command. Rank aside, follow her orders.」

stage0003_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Rank means little in a mixed unit like ours.
　Use your own judgment, within reason.」

stage0003_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$マオ$$
「So, that's the deal. Good to work with you.」

stage0003_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Whoa there, $$ミシェル$$.
　Trying to make a move on my boss...
　that's some serious death wish.」

stage0003_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「The tougher the target, the more a sniper
　wants to take the shot, $$クルツ$$.」

stage0003_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Ain't that the truth...!
　Looks like we'll be rivals, on duty and off.」

stage0003_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Watch that mouth, you'll give snipers
　everywhere a bad name. Now, introduce yourself.」

stage0003_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$$ＳＲＴ$$'s Sergeant $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$.
　Callsign $$ウルズ$$ 6, good to meet ya.」

stage0003_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Second Lieutenant $$ミハエル・ブラン$$.
　Please, call me $$ミシェル$$, Vice Captain.」

stage0003_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$マオ$$
「Maybe, if I feel like it.
　But is that wise? The captain
　seems pretty into you, y'know.」

stage0003_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$クラン$$
「Captain $$クラン・クラン$$...!
　As a Zentradi, I will not tolerate
　indecent conduct within this unit!」

stage0003_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Captain, as a Zentradi who's learned
　some culture, let's keep things civilized.」

stage0003_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$クラン$$
「Quiet...! I'll be watching you
　and $$ミシェル$$ very closely!」

stage0003_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$カナリア$$
「That's enough, $$クラン$$.
　...First Lieutenant $$カナリア・ベルシュタイン$$.
　I also serve as this ship's medic.」

stage0003_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Warrant Officer $$ルカ・アンジェローニ$$.
　I handle electronic warfare.」

stage0003_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$マオ$$
「Pretty standoffish, handsome.
　That sour about working with outsiders?」

stage0003_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$アルト$$
「...That's got nothing to do with it.」

stage0003_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$マオ$$
「Well... plenty of others are just as standoffish.」

stage0003_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n, since this is a fresh introduction,
　here's your chance to flip the script on
　'standoffish, silent type, wild-eyed, loner, gloomy'.」

stage0003_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$マオ$$
（Combat skills aside,
　seems like a real handful of a crew.）

stage0003_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$オズマ$$
「On top of this roster,
　$$ＩＣＰＯ$$ is sending $$金田正太郎$$'s $$鉄人$$ No. 28
　and the $$ブラックオックス#robot$$.」

stage0003_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$オズマ$$
「To make the most of this new strength,
　each of you will learn two-man cell tactics.」

stage0003_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$n
「Two-man cell...
　So, pairs of two, is it.」

stage0003_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Everyone, mount up!
　We're training against target drones!」

stage0003_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Team assignments
　will be announced on site!」

stage0003_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$マオ$$
（Well, now let's see what the devil,
　Major $$オズマ$$, can do...）

stage0003_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry for jumping on you like that...
　Guess I had you figured wrong.」

stage0003_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're a bit standoffish,
　but you're a guy I can count on.」

stage0003_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$宗介$$
「If you understand, that is enough.
　...I have something to say to you as well.」

stage0003_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Are you a man, or a woman?」

stage0003_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$オズマ$$
「What's wrong, $n?
　Worn out from back-to-back drills and combat?」

stage0003_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'll give you that much, you've got guts.」

stage0003_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$オズマ$$
「For that, from now on,
　I'll teach you how to fight, one-on-one.
　Whether you cry or scream about it.」

stage0003_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$マオ$$
「Good work today.
　Once you finish your report, I'll ship you
　to $$第２新東京市$$, go play with $$宗介$$ and the rest.」

stage0003_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$n
「No... I'll run sims until it's time.」

stage0003_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$マオ$$
「...Too much diligence is a problem too...」

stage0003_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$オズマ$$
「But they'll make a fine pilot.」

stage0003_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'm their coach.
　I'll make it happen.」

stage0003_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$マオ$$
「Understood, Major.
　Well... today's drill fixed the immediate issue.」

stage0003_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$マオ$$
「The question's how the enemy moves next.
　Too much about them doesn't add up.」

stage0003_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$マオ$$
「If we keep playing catch-up like this,
　it could lead somewhere we can't undo.」

stage0003_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$マオ$$
「...I'd guess I'm thinking the same thing.」

stage0003_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Whew... even guarding our little 'Angel,'
　the Quarter-to-safehouse commute wears you out.」

stage0003_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$マオ$$
「Quit your griping.
　Why do you think we rented the room
　across from her apartment in the first place?」

stage0003_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Says the boss, already on her second beer...!」

stage0003_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$マオ$$
「Don't be so uptight.
　Sounds like 'Angel' is about to turn in.」

stage0003_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$マオ$$
「She's on the phone with her sister overseas.
　...Sounds like they're talking about $$宗介$$, actually.」

stage0003_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$マオ$$
「There's the future to think about too.
　It's probably a private matter,
　so you're the only one who gets to listen.」

stage0003_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Yeah, he's a weird one.
　But, well...」

stage0003_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But, like, kind of...
　no, really weird, actually...
　but yeah! He's a fun one!」

stage0003_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Anyway, I've got one more
　call to make after this. Night, then.」

stage0003_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What is it? What'd she say?」

stage0003_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$宗介$$
「...$$千鳥かなめ$$ does not hate me, surprisingly...」

stage0003_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Ah, man, can't deal with this!
　Let's turn in too!」

stage0003_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$宗介$$, we'll take it from here, so sleep.
　Tomorrow's gonna be rough too.」

stage0003_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$マオ$$
（Hang in there.
　A reliable backup's about to show up.）

stage0003_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Honestly... your phone wouldn't connect at all,
　so ease up on the late-night stuff, okay?」

stage0003_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$n
「...It's not like I was out having fun...」

stage0003_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Anyway! Keep a proper eye
　on what Sagara's up to!」

stage0003_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$n
「Tell him that yourself.
　He wants your cell number too, by the way.」

stage0003_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... really? Well, maybe I will...」

stage0003_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry for calling so late.
　See you tomorrow... at school.」

stage0003_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$オカルトフォーラム$$
「～ Anonymous ～
　The $$時空震動$$ that hit Tokyo recently
　is the start of the world's end.」

stage0003_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$オカルトフォーラム$$
「～ Nameless ～
　If we still used the old century's calendar,
　every doomsday prophecy says this is the end.」

stage0003_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$オカルトフォーラム$$
「～ Unknown ～
　Ridiculous!
　The old $$マヤ$$ civilization's prophecy missed too!」

stage0003_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$オカルトフォーラム$$
「～ 《$$黒のカリスマ$$》 ～
　That's not so certain.
　The 'Age of the Sun' is coming soon.」

stage0003_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$オカルトフォーラム$$
「～ Anonymous ～
　This guy's a total 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》 newbie!
　Nobody buys $$黒のカリスマ$$ anymore!」

stage0003_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$オカルトフォーラム$$
「～ Knight ～
　Has anyone been caught in a dimensional tremor
　or a $$時空震動$$ and survived?」

stage0003_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$n
「...What are you doing in a place like this?」

stage0003_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, if it isn't $n.
　Fine work on that brutal training today.」

stage0003_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, well, you see,
　I consulted Master $$ジェフリー$$ and decided to
　set up $$ＤＥＭ$$ business in a corner of the hangar.」

stage0003_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Specifically, in exchange for the Z-Chips you all
　collect, I hand over goods $$ＤＥＭ$$ has developed.」

stage0003_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Simply put,
　it's human emotion converted into matter.」

stage0003_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Anger, sorrow, all sorts of feelings become Z-Chips,
　and the battlefield, where they run deepest,
　is by far the best place to harvest them.」

stage0003_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$ジェニオン$$ has a function to collect them,
　so with all your fine efforts,
　Z-Chips just keep piling up.」

stage0003_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$n
「That thing has a system like that too...」

stage0003_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Also, certain sortied members' feats,
　or a heated clash with a rival, can also
　generate Z-Chips.」

stage0003_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ＤＥＭ$$ uses them as a catalyst to develop
　all sorts of goods, and I'll be selling
　some of them right here.」

stage0003_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mind you, stocking the goods
　requires clearing various conditions...」

stage0003_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$n
「Knowing you, though,
　you'll have us fulfill those conditions yourself.」

stage0003_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, it's a real help how quick you are.」

stage0003_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, about those goods...
　unfortunately, due to various circumstances,
　even if stocked, supply will be limited.」

stage0003_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ＤＥＭ$$'s special enhancement parts and systems
　are sold in a single unit only.
　Buy it, and it's sold out.」

stage0003_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Also, since I am a dimensional trader myself,
　besides $$ＤＥＭ$$'s special standard goods...」

stage0003_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I plan to stock and sell parts
　developed in this world as well.
　Those rotate daily, so stock changes as we go.」

stage0003_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$n
「Should add a bit to our fighting strength.」

stage0003_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Also, right here, I'll be offering
　congratulations to anyone who's downed
　over 80 units and become an ace pilot.」

stage0003_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For now, since I'll be in everyone's
　debt going forward, I've arranged
　about 1000 Z as a token of thanks.」

stage0003_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「First, please take a look at the lineup
　I risked my life to bring here.
　Now then, let's get to it, business, business!」
